loginDescription: Sign in to manage requests and notifications on this device.
visitorNote: Customers can send requests without an account.
autoRefresh: Updates every 30 seconds while this page is visible.
emptyDescription: New requests will appear here. Customers do not need an account.
pending: Notifications waiting to retry. Requests are already saved.
refreshError: Unable to refresh. Showing the last successful update.
readError: Unable to update this request. Please try again.
logoutError: Unable to sign out. Please try again.
notificationDescription: Install the site and allow notifications. Alerts include a request summary; open the private dashboard for full details.
httpsMessage: This address uses HTTP. Phone notifications require a trusted HTTPS address. Requests remain available in the dashboard.
installMessage: On iPhone/iPad, open in Safari, choose Share → Add to Home Screen, then open the icon, sign in and enable notifications. iOS/iPadOS 16.4+ is required.
unsupportedMessage: Use an updated browser that supports Web Push.
deniedMessage: Allow notifications in the browser’s site settings, then reopen this dashboard.
serverNotConfigured: Notifications have not been configured on this server.
pushInitError: Unable to confirm notifications. Try enabling them again.
pushEnabled: Notifications are registered on this device. Send a test to check receipt.
testAccepted: The push service accepted the test. Check your device.
testFailed: Unable to send the test. Try enabling this device again.
installAndroid: Open the browser menu and choose Install app or Add to Home Screen. Then open the icon and sign in.
devicePrivacy: Request details may appear on the lock screen. Disable all devices if an enrolled device is lost.
deviceInstructions: Android: browser menu → Install app. iPhone: Safari → Share → Add to Home Screen. Open the installed icon, sign in and allow notifications. Installing alone does not grant permission.
genericError: Unable to complete this action. Please try again.
